check_scope: complete saved FP64 recurrence and metric replay; --recompute additionally checks 192 full gradients and 302 readouts using separate forward/head/reverse algorithms; no new training

gates.scope: training mechanism threshold only; no automatic optimizer or hardware promotion

recipe.backward: common real-centering selected-route STE; not the derivative of floor
recipe.c: arithmetic mean of m over all tokens in the 32 saved normalized shared-initial train logits
recipe.forward: dynamic first-tie routes and floor centering, continuous bounded FP64 weights
recipe.forward_audit: separate fractional floor-forward selector; full logits/routes/offsets checked
recipe.gradient_audit: independent reverse via autograd on detached-cotangent fixed-route affine replay
recipe.initialization: identical inherited diverse fitted weights; no new fitting
recipe.orders_scope: fixed order sensitivity on the same examples, not independent initialization seeds
recipe.recurrence: stored FP64 W-G/2**18; no exact integer cumulative-shadow claim
recipe.scale_scope: equal mean nominal head mass, not equal parameter-gradient norm or realized update norm
recipe.state: FP64 weights only; no EF remainder or native optimizer state

scope: FP64 selected-route training mechanism control; no native recipe, held-out quality or hardware claim

calibration.scope: frozen before new trajectories; no target-based tuning
